segment.source:
::His wounds mended, his pain relieved, the man speaks to you with reemerging liveness.::
Stranger... thank you! I owe my life to you. If it weren't for you, I'd be a rotting corpse now and, and... Thank you, thank you! How can I repay you, friend?<end>
segment.target:
::His wounds mended, his pain relieved, the man speaks to you with reemerging liveness.::

segment.source: Saving someone's life is its own reward.<end>
segment.target: Saving someone's life is its own reward.<end>

segment.source: Hold on a second, friend. <end>
segment.target: Hold on a second, friend. <end>

segment.source: Here's sixty charons. That is all the money I have. ::He hands you 60 Stygian Coins.:: Thank you so much!<end>
segment.target: Here's sixty charons. That is all the money I have. ::He hands you 60 Stygian Coins.:: Thank you so much!<end>

segment.source: Thank you. Best of luck in the future. Take care.<end>
segment.target: Thank you. Best of luck in the future. Take care.<end>

segment.source: Wait, wait, wait... What is your name?<end>
segment.target: Wait, wait, wait... What is your name?<end>

segment.source: $(context.player.Name).<end>
segment.target: $(context.player.Name).<end>

segment.source: I'm Fergus. Thank you, $(context.player.Name). Thank you again. Good luck to you too.<end>
segment.target: I'm Fergus. Thank you, $(context.player.Name). Thank you again. Good luck to you too.<end>

segment.source: I'd rather that my name remains unknown.<end>
segment.target: I'd rather that my name remains unknown.<end>

segment.source: Well... friend, thank you. Thank you again. Good luck to you too.<end>
segment.target: Well... friend, thank you. Thank you again. Good luck to you too.<end>

segment.source: ::Wave goodbye and leave without a word.::<end>
segment.target: ::Wave goodbye and leave without a word.::<end>

segment.source: Thank you again. Good luck to you too.<end>
segment.target: Thank you again. Good luck to you too.<end>

segment.source: ::Turn around and leave.::<end>
segment.target: ::Turn around and leave.::<end>

segment.source: Nice. See ya.<end>
segment.target: Nice. See ya.<end>

segment.source: ::He searches through his pockets.:: I... I had some money but... ::He continues searching.:: Damn it! I must have lost it somehow.<end>
segment.target: ::He searches through his pockets.:: I... I had some money but... ::He continues searching.:: Damn it! I must have lost it somehow.<end>

segment.source: ::After having failed to find the money, he pauses to think. He looks at you, then at his bloodied belt, and without any hesitation he removes it.:: You know what? Take this belt. It's a bullet strap belt. If you don't wanna use it, you can at least sell it. That is all I can give you, sadly.<end>

segment.source: I don't need anything. Just take care.<end>
segment.target: I don't need anything. Just take care.<end>

segment.source: Got some coins?<end>
segment.target: Got some coins?<end>

segment.source: Of course! <end>
segment.target: Of course! <end>

segment.source: The meds don't come cheap, you know...<end>
segment.target: The meds don't come cheap, you know...<end>

segment.source: Goodbye... and thank you again.<end>
segment.target: Goodbye... and thank you again.<end>

segment.source:
Please... help me...
::Says the man as he reaches for you with a bloodied arm, his fingers spread wide. You see numerous wounds on his body, open and bleeding, each one a partial contributor to the large red pool in which he stands; but it is the wound you don't see that is the most threatening, the one which he firmly presses with his other, trembling hand. He pleads again in a fading voice.::
I am... dying...<end>

segment.source: That Lurker... bastard... ambushed me.<end>
segment.target: That Lurker... bastard... ambushed me.<end>

segment.source: Help...<end>
segment.target: Help...<end>

segment.source: Stand still while I bandage your wounds.<end>
segment.target: Stand still while I bandage your wounds.<end>

segment.source: Thank you...<end>
segment.target: Thank you...<end>

segment.source: Please! Don't leave me to... die here.<end>

segment.source: Why do... ::The man never gets the chance to finish his sentence, as his body drops lifeless next to the man whom he killed - the man who killed him.::<end>
